content: It is one of the blessings of old friends that you can afford to be stupid with them.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Enduring friendships create an effortless space of psychological safety, where one is freed from the tiring burden of performance and intellect.
practicalInsight: Celebrate the lighthearted, playful ease of a long-standing friendship without needing seriousness.
reflectionPrompt: When was the last time you shared pure, uncalculated laughter with someone who loves you?
